# How much weather can your kayak or boat rental lose, and is another boat worth buying?

> Free kayak, paddleboard and boat rental business calculator: fleet, rental length, price, weekday and weekend demand, staff and weather days in; season profit, rainy-day break-even, turned-away rentals, what one more boat earns and best price out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
